value.name: Dicky runs toward the restaurant
value.description: Dicky sprints down the street toward the Olympia Restaurant, drawing attention as police sirens sound nearby.
evidence: Dicky running down the street toward the restaurant, passing the COSMOPOLITAN CAFE, crowd of people out front, BOUNCER, 6'4", 230 lbs., sirens in the air.

value.name: Bouncer taunts Dicky
value.description: The bouncer blocks Dicky and mocks him, implying he is high and incoherent.
evidence: BOUNCER (puts his hand up, shakes HIS HEAD) Whoa, spucky teeth, I thought you were smokin' rocks, now you're gargling with 'em?

value.name: Dicky threatens the bouncer
value.description: Dicky mutters a threat in response to the bouncer's taunt.
evidence: DICKY (looks away, mumbles) You're 'bout to lose your breath.

value.name: Dicky assaults the bouncer
value.description: Dicky attacks the bouncer, knocking him down and out with a series of punches.
evidence: And Dicky nails the bouncer in the gut, drops him to his knees, wind knocked out of him, then Dicky hooks his jaw... 6'4" guy dropping fast, hitting the sidewalk, sickening thud.

value.name: Dicky fights police
value.description: When a pursuing cop reaches him, Dicky punches him and then swings at another officer as more police arrive.
evidence: COP CHASING HIM on foot runs up, Dicky PUNCHES HIM OUT. Busting open his nose, blood pouring. Dicky takes a swing at ANOTHER COP. More police cars pull up.

value.name: Police arrest Dicky
value.description: Officers tackle Dicky to the ground and he resists violently as they arrest him.
evidence: Officers jump out and slam Dicky to the ground! Dicky screams, fighting back, kicking and punching the police arresting him...

value.name: Micky discusses fight strategy
value.description: Inside the restaurant, Micky O'Keefe talks about reviewing tape and how Micky should cut down the ring against Belinc.
evidence: OLYMPIA RESTAURANT - NIGHT MICKEY O'KEEFE We were lookin' at tape today on Belinc and I think if Micky cuts down the ring in most rounds --

value.name: Dicky is recognized in the diner
value.description: Someone in the restaurant identifies Dicky, causing a stir among the patrons and Micky's family.
evidence: GUY IN DINER Dicky! IT'S Dicky ECKLUND!

value.name: Mickey rushes outside
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe jumps up and heads for the door as the others follow Alice outside.
evidence: Mickey O'Keefe jumps up, starts for the door.
Alice still holding Micky's lobby card, heads outside with George, Sherry, sisters.

value.name: Charlene restrains Micky
value.description: Charlene pulls Micky back down and tries to keep him from going outside.
evidence: Micky stands up. Charlene pulls him back down.

value.name: Mickey warns Micky not to get hurt
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe shouts for Micky to stay inside because he does not want him injured before the fight.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE (glances back, shouts) Don't, Micky! I don't want ya gettin' hurt before the fight!

value.name: Micky ignores Charlene and goes outside
value.description: Despite Charlene's attempts to stop him, Micky breaks free and leaves her behind to follow the commotion outside.
evidence: He rushes out after Alice, George, Red Dog, Sherry leaving Micky and Charlene behind.
Hear more SIRENS, SCREAMS from the street.
Micky can't take it, jumps up.
CHARLENE MICKEY O'KEEFE Are you kiddin' me? Are you Are you for real? Sit down. serious? Sit down, sit. Sit down.
She grabs the back of his pants.. .he drags her a little, pushes her hand off, leaves her outstretched, hair fallen over her face.
